title: Keep a small ZIP map member after its batch has drafted
qualification: Offline regression only; no runtime gate pass, processor or database rehearsal
cause: The map retain did not name its ZIP's batch item at any of its four package-rule checks.
change: Reuse the existing internal ArchiveMemberLineage.parentSourceId passed by the ZIP job; no new argument needed.
retain parses that source id and carries it through RetainOriginalContext, including processor-error recovery.
service.ts:414,564,589,609 pass it to workspace; its same-case batch membership and property rules are unchanged.
The HTTP retain route passes three arguments and rejects lineage and batchSourceId as unknown form fields.
No contract, route, storage authority, case-revision fence, receipt digest or deduplication rule changed.

testsFirst.baseline: One acceptance regression failed at service.ts:561 with STALE_REVISION; four refusal checks passed.
testsFirst.boundary: Real retain and SQL authority with TC2 memoryPool; processor fetch and object I/O stubbed.
assertions: A real small GeoJSON is retained with lineage while a sibling's package already exists; response schema passes.
Replay and another-key duplicate use one source, object, processor call and revision bump.
An officer drop, non-batch parent, or property link refuses before I/O, also when replaying a saved receipt.
A property-linked case refuses even without packages; batchSourceId in the public input cannot grant access.
Processor failure keeps the original under the same fence; retry attaches its receipt without another copy.
ZIP job retry assertions keep the original member count and item count unchanged in its existing ledger.
